name: jev-gate
description: One Claude Code plugin from the jev-gate repository: extractive compaction, a Jev effort and model router, and an orchestration gate. Gate, Compact, and the Router are on by default, and each of those three has a switch. gateMode off does not turn the others off.

plugins.name: jev-gate
plugins.description: Extractive compaction, a Jev effort and model router, and an orchestration gate, in one install. Gate, Compact, and the Router are on by default, and each of those three has a switch. Needs Node 22. A TypeSafe key is separate from a Claude login. The plugin configures Function Hooks automatically for compaction and routing.
